records.issue_text: lib/topic_retriever.rb:26-29 uses setnx followed by a separate expire non-atomically, so a crash between calls leaves the key without a TTL and throttles that embed_url forever
records.rationale: In lib/topic_retriever.rb#retrieved_recently?, throttling uses `$redis.setnx(retrieved_key, "1")` followed by a separate `$redis.expire(retrieved_key, 60)`. If the process crashes or is interrupted after `setnx` succeeds but before `expire` runs, the key will persist without a TTL, causing `setnx` to fail on subsequent calls and `retrieved_recently?` to return `true` forever for that `embed_url`.

records.issue_text: app/models/topic_embed.rb:12 mutates the caller's string in place with `contents << ...`, corrupting reused content and raising on frozen strings
records.rationale: In `TopicEmbed.import`, the line `contents << "\n<hr>..."` appends to the passed-in `contents` String in place. This is verifiable from the diff and can produce unintended side effects if the caller reuses `contents` after calling `import`, and it will raise a `FrozenError` if `contents` is a frozen string.

records.issue_text: app/assets/javascripts/embed.js:5-11 lacks a null check on document.getElementById('discourse-comments'), so appendChild throws and breaks the host page's JS if the container is missing
records.rationale: In app/assets/javascripts/embed.js, `comments` is assigned from `document.getElementById('discourse-comments')` and then unconditionally used as `comments.appendChild(iframe);`. If the container element is missing, `comments` will be `null` and this will throw at runtime, breaking the embedding script (and potentially other JS on the host page).
